title: My Body
text: Look at my body! I have one head with two eyes, one nose, and one mouth. I have two ears too. My arms and hands help me hold things. My legs and feet help me run and jump. Every part of my body is important.

questions.question: How many eyes does the writer have?
questions.source_sentence: I have one head with two eyes, one nose, and one mouth.

questions.question: What helps the writer run and jump?
questions.source_sentence: My legs and feet help me run and jump.

questions.question: What helps the writer hold things?
questions.source_sentence: My arms and hands help me hold things.
